newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae Inv sees 15-20 pct '97 sales hike.
newsitem.headline: Sonae Inv sees 15-20 pct '97 sales hike.

text.p: Portuguese retail group Sonae Investimentos said it expected to post a 15-20 percent increase in sales in 1997 compared to 1996.

"We are expecting an increase in turnover of between 15 and 20 percent, supported by a higher rate of growth of distribution activities in Portugal and Brazil and the impact of new business in specialised retail activity," said a report distributed at the presentation of the group's 1996 results.
Sonae Investimentos's 1996 consolidated sales were 451 billion escudos.
